speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-viral bronchitis with secondary bacterial superinfection in a patient with confirmed Cushing's syndrome (bilateral adrenal hyperplasia). While the adrenal findings are noted, the acute presentation of productive cough, purulent sputum, and shortness of breath lasting three weeks post-cold is most consistent with bronchitis complicated by infection.
